faq.investor.q1: How does WifiSenseBox compete with cheaper motion sensors?
faq.investor.a1: Motion sensors only detect movement; WifiSenseBox provides rich posture, presence, and vitality data comparable to cameras but without the privacy risk or image data liability.
faq.investor.a2: Our moat is the proprietary Edge-AI models trained on millions of multi-modal WiFi/Radar data points, combined with our direct-to-enterprise distribution model.
faq.investor.a3: We have two patents pending regarding CSI-based posture reconstruction and multi-user breath isolation in high-multipath environments.
faq.general.q1: Can it detect me through a closed door?
faq.general.a1: Yes. WiFi waves penetrate standard walls and doors, allowing a single unit to often cover multiple adjacent rooms depending on building material.
faq.general.q2: Does it record audio or video?
faq.general.a2: No. WifiSenseBox has no microphone and no camera lens. It strictly analyzes radio wave patterns, making it physically impossible to capture images or sound.
faq.general.a3: Our AI is specifically trained to distinguish the signal 'fingerprint' of humans from pets, filtering out four-legged movement to prevent false alarms.
faq.general.q4: Do I need to pay for a subscription?
faq.general.a4: The Basic Awareness tier is included. Advanced AI features like Fall Detection or Fleet Analytics require a monthly subscription to cover cloud processing and 24/7 monitoring costs.
faq.tech.q1: Does it work through thick concrete walls?
faq.tech.a1: While WiFi signals penetrate standard drywall and wood easily, very thick reinforced concrete may limit the range to 1-2 rooms. We recommend one unit per 800 sq ft for best performance in concrete buildings.
faq.tech.q2: Which WiFi bands does it use?
faq.tech.a2: It utilizes both 2.4GHz and 5GHz bands for sensing, plus a dedicated 60GHz mmWave radar for sub-millimeter precision of vital signs.
faq.tech.q3: Is the AI processing done locally?
faq.tech.a3: Yes. To ensure zero-latency and maximum privacy, the majority of signal analysis happens directly on the WifiSenseBox's Edge-NPU. Only anonymized events are sent to the dashboard.
